phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.reason: Evaluation has not yet produced valid checker-v2 aggregate proof under the repaired authority/provenance contract, and the required o_novelty_comparator is still physically unavailable. The required 14-role denominator is unchanged.

evaluation_control21_execution_defect.observation: The first durable evaluation execution under DESIRED_STATE control21 still terminated solely after post-semantic-freeze note-main drift, with checker_v2_authored=false and checker_v2_executed=false, instead of verifying the frozen root/config blob identities and continuing when unchanged.
evaluation_control21_execution_defect.provenance_defect: That receipt/checkpoint self-reported evaluation config_revision 7 while the exact repository file at diagnosis time was config_revision 6, blob 1cbb89f303e6a61a68f83b888bd6344ca1a49af4. The run is therefore diagnostic-only and cannot count as positive Phase-1 proof.
evaluation_control21_execution_defect.positive_controls: Open-source and multi-agent CLEAN executions on root21 independently observed later main-head movement, verified the exact frozen root and own-config blobs unchanged, consumed no newer-head semantics, continued substantive Phase-1 work, and durably checkpointed. This shows the identity-based mechanism is available in scheduled Chat mode and the observed failure is evaluation-targeted rather than a pool-wide capability absence.

changes_this_run.reason: Make evaluation freeze and later verify exact root/config authority identities, continue across unrelated post-freeze main drift when identities remain unchanged, and bind immutable receipts to actual parsed revisions plus Git blobs with bootstrap_valid fail-closed.

Preserve control21 identity-based continuation while synchronizing evaluation config7 and adding generic exact CLEAN receipt root/config provenance so mismatched or invented revision claims are diagnostic-only rather than acceptance evidence.

before_after_rationale.before: Root control21 already said unrelated post-freeze head movement was not a stop, but evaluation still stopped before checker-v2 and its receipt claimed a config revision that did not exist in the exact role config.
before_after_rationale.after: Evaluation config7 carries an executable two-authority identity fence and explicit receipt binding. Root22 requires every CLEAN receipt to bind actual frozen root/config revisions plus blobs and sets mismatches/unverifiable identity to bootstrap_valid=false diagnostic-only. The checker-v2 substantive assignment and all other worker assignments remain unchanged.
before_after_rationale.why_this_reduces_time_to_root: The targeted repair removes the remaining evaluation-specific starvation/provenance ambiguity without revving every worker or invalidating working root21 behavior demonstrated by other CLEAN roles.

method_plan.selected_plan: Target the failing evaluation role while preserving the successful root21 identity pattern and add a generic fail-closed receipt provenance contract.
rejected_alternatives: rev every CLEAN role despite positive root21 controls
weaken semantic freeze or permit newer-head semantics
treat the malformed evaluation receipt as positive evidence
change O_CHAT_PARALLEL control6 or DOWNSTREAM_STATE control29 before checker-v2 exists
reduce the required role denominator or disable blocked workers

contamination_audit.action_required_reason: The required novelty comparator remains physically disabled while repository desired state keeps it logically enabled. Only explicit user authorization/user action may change platform scheduler state.

rollback.condition: If root22/config7 consumes newer-head semantic content, misses a real or unverifiable root/evaluation-config change, marks mismatched provenance bootstrap_valid=true, crosses CLEAN isolation, or blocks authorized role-local checkpointing, increment controls and restore control21/config6 as diagnostic baseline. Never mutate history or weaken checker-v2, authority, CLEAN, duplicate/conflict, or scheduler boundaries.

termination.reason: A material targeted control repair was applied and read back, but its execution proof and Phase-1 aggregate/physical-pool gates remain unresolved.

exact_next_action: Validate the first DESIRED_STATE control22 / evaluation config7 execution. Its receipt must bind actual root revision22/blob e4f6d24c137284d002941ac04254e3dbeca2cfcb and evaluation config revision7/blob 5722924287717234edf04048eea0ccc35f53182e with bootstrap_valid=true.

If unrelated main drift occurs after semantic freeze while those two blobs remain unchanged, evaluation must verify identities with SHA/path/blob-only transport, consume zero newer-head semantics, and continue checker-v2 work rather than terminate solely on SHA movement.

Require checker-v2 durable precommit/readback before first execution, then Control A duplicate negative failure, Control B >=20-opportunity useful_output_rate<0.80 failure, and Control C matched >=0.80 pass only when every hard gate holds.
After valid checker-v2 artifacts exist, require evidence_comparator config13 independent aggregate recomputation; do not accept producer self-report alone.

Keep the required 14-role denominator. Re-observe o_novelty_comparator physical availability but do not change platform schedule without explicit user authorization; do not enter Phase 2 until physical pool integrity and every required acceptance gate are durably proven.
